newsitem.title: USA: Hudson Foods 1.0 pct of sales hurt by recall.
newsitem.headline: Hudson Foods 1.0 pct of sales hurt by recall.

text.p: Hudson Foods Inc said the ground beef products associated with last week's meat recall involve sales revenues of less than 1.0 percent of the company's total sales.
The company had sales of $1.4 billion in fiscal 1996, it said.

On Friday, the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) ordered Hudson Foods to recall some 1.2 million pounds of frozen ground beef nationwide due to possible contamination with a deadly strain of the E. coli bacteria.
The recall was in addition to a voluntary recall by the company of some of its hamburger patties earlier in the week after the meat was linked to 16 cases of human illness in Colorado in July.
The USDA has warned consumers who have bought Hudson Farms frozen patties since June 4 to return any unused portion to where it was purchased.
